_what: Date strings a source printed that the service's date reader cannot read as a calendar day, month or year, declared here so gate G1 can tell 'a source printed something odd' from 'the reader is defective'. A string in a date family that neither parses nor appears here FAILS G1. Every entry carries a source record so it can be looked at.
_rule: The stored string is never rewritten. Declaring a string here records that it was looked at; it does not make it a date. The claim stays in the store and on the person, marked unreadable, beside any other value the man holds.
_status: CONFIRMED by Ryan 2026-09-07: nothing can be done with these; they stay declared as unreadable with their source records. Each entry stays provisional in the sense that if the source ever corrects the string, G1 fails on the stale entry and it must be REMOVED here rather than the corrected string being silently reread.

Ryan then ruled that a source may declare its own date format with the evidence behind it, so `crippen-aafc-register` declares MDY in date-formats-by-source.json and the reading now reads them.
